title: Make PgWire nested array results decodable by PostgreSQL JDBC

steps.step: Audit BENCHPROD-105 Q14 PgArray decode failure and PgWire Value::Array encoding
Encode Value::Array results as PostgreSQL brace array literals instead of Rust debug strings
Infer array result metadata as PostgreSQL array OIDs, including CTE-derived Q14 path projections
Force array result fields to text format so payload format matches field metadata
Add PgJDBC pg_type array element metadata coverage required by PgArray.getArray()
Run Rust regressions, release build, and bounded native LDBC 40-row smoke

result.current_frontier: No Q14 PgArray blocker remains in the bounded 40-row command smoke. Broader LDBC native readiness still needs larger/unbounded runs and other query paths.

remaining_blockers: This is bounded 40-row LDBC command evidence, not a full native LDBC benchmark pass.
Full LDBC workload remains unproven outside the prefix40 Q1/Q14 command path.
20-row Q14 diagnostics remain vulnerable to unreachable parameter-pair artifacts.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-107 candidate: broaden native LDBC from prefix40 Q1/Q14 pass to additional query paths or larger preload, preserving non-isolation evidence labels.
